# Data Folder Overview

This folder contains data used in the mapping of sanitation and SMDW access in LMICs. It is organised into `raw/` and `processed/`.

**Data is not stored in this repository.**

1.  Large input files (household survey microdata, GEE-sampled covariates, country-level covariate tables) are stored on the switchdrive and referenced via `configuration/paths.R`. These are marked with 📁 *switchdrive* below.
2.  Boundary files are available to download from the links mentioned below.
3.  Several files described here are generated by the pipeline as intermediate steps and are not shared in the repository to keep its size manageable.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## `raw/`

Original input data. Not modified by any script.

### `DHS_boundaries/`

Survey-level geographic boundary shapefiles from the DHS Program, one subfolder per country-year survey (e.g. `Kenya 2022 DHS/shps/`). Downloaded directly from the DHS spatial data repository without modification.

-   **Source:** [spatialdata.dhsprogram.com](https://spatialdata.dhsprogram.com)
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`

### `MICS_boundaries/`

Survey-level geographic boundary shapefiles from UNICEF MICS, split into:

-   `Countries_Water_Quality/` — surveys with water quality data
-   `Countries_Other/` — remaining MICS surveys

Downloaded for surveys with GIS data (only a subset of MICS countries have these).

-   **Source:** <https://mics.unicef.org/surveys>
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`

### `other_boundaries/`

Boundary shapefiles for surveys not from DHS or MICS where GADM boundaries could not be matched to names.

-   **Sources:** <https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-npl>, <https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-kaz>
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`

### `GADM36_boundaries/`

GADM version 3.6 administrative boundary shapefiles for all LMICs, one subfolder per country (ISO3 code). Downloaded individually from the GADM website and merged. Includes:

-   `admin1/` — admin level 1 shapefiles for all countries

-   `gadm_lmics_final.shp` — single merged shapefile covering all LMIC boundaries, used as the prediction grid geometry

-   **Source:** [gadm.org](https://gadm.org), version 3.6

-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`, `scripts/04_additional_analysis/02_map_sanitation_predictions.py`

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Switchdrive — raw inputs

The following raw data files are stored on the switchdrive and are not tracked in this repository.

#### 📁 Household survey microdata

Individual-level DHS and MICS survey data, organised by survey type:

| Path (relative to switchdrive root) | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/HH_DHS_water_quality/` | DHS surveys with water quality data |
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/HH_DHS_other/` | DHS surveys for sanitation and all other drinking water subcomponents |
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/HH_DHS_MIS/` | DHS Malaria Indicator Surveys |
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/HH_MICS_old_SMDW/` | Older MICS surveys with water quality data (previously used in Greenwood et al., 2024) |
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/HH_MICS_new_SMDW/` | Newer MICS surveys with water quality data (new SMDW module) |
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/HH_MICS_new_other/` | Newer MICS surveys without water quality data |
| `HH_surveys/HH_survey_data/df_SMDW_oldMICS.csv` | Compiled old MICS water quality records |

-   **Source:** DHS Program / UNICEF MICS
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/01a–01d` (compile and label scripts)

#### 📁 GADM region names table

| Path | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `regions/all_regions_GADM.csv` | All GADM version 3.6 admin level 1–4 names for LMICs in long format, used for fuzzy name matching |

-   **Source:** [gadm.org](https://gadm.org/old_versions.html)
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/02_matching_survey_gadm_names.qmd`

#### 📁 GEE-sampled geospatial covariates

Covariates extracted from Google Earth Engine (GEE), stored as population-weighted sums per survey region or admin unit. Sampled onto boundaries in `data/processed/survey_boundaries/`.

| Path | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `geospatial_covariates/pop_sums_training_water_quality/` | Population sums for water quality survey regions |
| `geospatial_covariates/pop_sums_training_other/` | Population sums for other survey regions |
| `geospatial_covariates/pop_sums_prediction/` | Population sums for GADM prediction grid |
| `geospatial_covariates/water_quality_covariates_nonpop_v4.csv` | A range of geospatial covariates for water quality surveys (v4) |
| `geospatial_covariates/other_surveys_covariates_nonpop_v3.csv` | A range of geospatial covariates for other surveys (v3) |

-   **Produced by:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/04a`, `04b`, `05_prepare_prediction_data.qmd`

#### 📁 Country-level covariates

| Path | Description | Source |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| `geospatial_covariates/gdp_per_capita_2015.csv` | GDP per capita (2015 USD) by country | [World Development Indicators](https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators/#) |
| `geospatial_covariates/secondary_education_years.csv` | Mean years of secondary education by country | [World Development Indicators](https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators/#) |

#### 📁 Geogenic groundwater risk estimates

Admin1-level estimates of the population using groundwater at risk of arsenic and fluoride contamination. Derived from:

-   Podgorski, J., & Berg, M. (2020). Global threat of arsenic in groundwater. *Science*, 368(6493), 845–850.
-   Podgorski, J., & Berg, M. (2022). Global analysis and prediction of fluoride in groundwater. *Nature Communications*, 13(1), 4232.
-   JMP national-level drinking water usage estimates ([washdata.org](https://washdata.org/data))
-   WorldPop spatial population estimates (Bondarenko et al., 2025; [DOI:10.5258/SOTON/WP00845](https://doi.org/10.5258/SOTON/WP00845))

| Path | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `drinking_water_estimates/geogenic_groundwater_risk_estimates.xlsx` | Admin1-level population at risk from arsenic and fluoride contamination |

-   **Used in:** `scripts/04_additional_analysis/06_calculating_SMDW.qmd`

#### 📁 Deliverable outputs

Final model output files written to the switchdrive. These are not inputs to any further pipeline step.

| Path | Description | Produced by |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| `deliverables_0002020937/smdw_estimates_admin1.csv` | Admin1-level SMDW estimates with arsenic/fluoride risk components | `scripts/04_additional_analysis/06_calculating_SMDW.qmd` |
| `deliverables_0002020937/datasets/sanitation_estimates_admin1.csv` | Admin1-level basic sanitation and open defecation estimates with prediction intervals | `scripts/01_data_preparation/06_format_final_sanitation_dataframe.qmd` |

## `processed/`

Data derived from raw inputs, prepared by scripts in this repository unless otherwise noted.

### `household_surveys/`

Compiled and labelled household survey extracts, one file per survey type and outcome. These are the direct outputs of the compile-and-label scripts and serve as inputs to the training dataframe preparation step.

| File | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `df_sanitation_MICS_v1.csv` | MICS with sanitation data |
| `df_sanitation_DHS.csv` | DHS with sanitation data |
| `df.SMDW_wq_MICS_old.csv` | Old MICS with water quality survey data (used in Greenwood et al., 2024) |
| `df.SMDW_wq_MICS_new.csv` | New MICS with water quality survey data |
| `df.SMDW_other_MICS.csv` | MICS with data other SMDW subcomponents |
| `df.SMDW_wq_DHS.csv` | DHS with water quality data |
| `df.SMDW_other_DHS.csv` | DHS with other SMDW subcomponent data |

-   **Produced by:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/01a–01d`
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/04a`, `04b`

### `survey_boundaries/`

Processed survey boundary shapefiles prepared for upload to Google Earth Engine for covariate sampling. Includes cleaned and merged geometries for water quality surveys, other surveys, and the GADM prediction grid, plus region area tables.

-   **Produced by:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`
-   **Used in:** `scripts/04_additional_analysis/01_map_sanitation_training_data.py`, `03_sanitation_descriptive_statistics.py`

### `overview_water_quality_data_v2.csv`

Manually compiled overview table of all surveys included in the water quality analysis, with metadata on survey type, country, year, and available modules.

-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`

### `P04-00-DHS_Boundaries_v1.0.csv`

Manually compiled index of DHS boundary availability — lists which surveys have associated shapefiles in the DHS spatial repository.

-   **Source:** DHS Program
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`

### `crosswalk_review/`

Tables that link survey region names to GADM administrative region names. Produced by `scripts/01_data_preparation/02_matching_survey_gadm_names.qmd` through a combination of exact matching, fuzzy matching, and manual review.

**Per-indicator crosswalk files** (one set per indicator: `basic_sanitation`, `open_defecation`, `ecoli_free`, `accessibility`, `availability`, `improved_source`, `smdw`):

-   `*_initial.csv` — auto-matched (exact + fuzzy)
-   `*_review_needed.csv` — regions flagged as uncertain after auto-matching, reviewed manually
-   `*_final.csv` — finalised crosswalk after manual corrections

The `final_match_status_*` files are intermediate outputs listing all survey regions with their matched GADM name and match type. These were manually reviewed to identify and correct mismatched provinces before being used to define the regions to be sampled in `03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`.

**Supporting files:**

| File | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `final_match_status_oldMICS_SMDW.csv` | Match status for old MICS SMDW surveys (includes water quality) |
| `covariate_region_names.csv` | Region names extracted from covariate data, used for name harmonisation |
| `join_names_outcome.csv` | Lookup table harmonising country/region names in the outcome data |
| `join_names_covariates.csv` | Lookup table harmonising country/region names in the covariate data |
| `nonpop_covariates_training_headers.csv` | Column headers from non-population covariate files, used to verify join structure |
| `region_crosswalk_with_WB_country_names.csv` | Full crosswalk after adding World Bank standardised country names |
| `region_crosswalk_review_needed.csv` | Unresolved regions across all indicators (combined) |

-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/04a_sanitation_preparing_training_dataframes.qmd`, `04b_SMDW_preparing_training_dataframes.qmd`

### `sampled_features/`

Region area tables and non-population covariate files produced by `03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb` after GEE sampling. These are used alongside the switchdrive covariate files when assembling the training and prediction dataframes.

| File | Description |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `water_quality_region_areas_km2.csv` | Region areas (km²) for water quality survey regions |
| `other_surveys_region_areas_km2.csv` | Region areas (km²) for other survey regions |
| `gadm_lmic_region_areas_km2.csv` | Region areas (km²) for GADM prediction grid units |
| `nonpop_prediction_v2.csv` | Non-population geospatial covariates for the prediction grid |

-   **Produced by:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/03_sampling_geospatial_data.ipynb`
-   **Used in:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/04a`, `04b`, `05_prepare_prediction_data.qmd`

### `training_subcomponents/`

Training datasets with survey outcome data joined to geospatial covariates, one file per indicator. Indicators covered: `basic_sanitation`, `open_defecation`, `accessibility`, `availability`, `improved_source`, `ecoli_free`, `ecoli`, `smdw`.

Each indicator has a corresponding `*_missing_covariates_after_join.csv` logging survey regions that could not be matched to covariates, used for quality control.

-   **Produced by:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/04a_sanitation_preparing_training_dataframes.qmd`, `04b_SMDW_preparing_training_dataframes.qmd`
-   **Used in:** `scripts/03_model_training/01a`, `01b` (RF models), `02a`, `02b` (TabPFN models)

### `prediction/prediction_covariates_2024.csv`

Covariate dataset for all LMIC admin1 units, structured as the prediction dataframe. Contains the same features as the training data but covering all admin1 units globally (reference year: 2024).

-   **Produced by:** `scripts/01_data_preparation/05_prepare_prediction_data.qmd`
-   **Used in:** `scripts/02_feature_selection/01_cluster_analysis.qmd`, `scripts/03_model_training/01a`, `01b`, `02a`, `02b`
